capabilities: Add a Preview column to a Bases table view
Expand a preview on hover to read the full excerpt
Create a new note pre-filled with the properties the base filters on
Preview the full note body or text under a specific heading
Set the preview length in settings
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13 or later; manual installation is recommended for now. Versions before 1.1.0 injected cells into the built-in table DOM and stopped showing previews after Obsidian 1.15 rebuilt that table.
intentEvidence: The plugin registers its own view type with the public Bases API (registerBasesView).
motivation: Built in response to a request by u/tashmoo and u/DeliriumTrigger in a Reddit thread asking for inline note previews in Bases table rows with quick-add.
problem: Bases tables only show properties, so you have to open each note to see what it actually contains.
summary: Bases view that adds a note-content preview column to table rows and a button to create notes matching the base's filters.
